acceptanceCriteria: TestPSRSweepOwnerBarrier passes 20/20 with -count=20 at load average >=40, or its timing dependence is removed; the fix does not weaken what the barrier asserts.
A note records whether the program_* 30m timeout in the store package is the same class; if it is a different class, it is filed separately.
body: Observed 2026-10-16 by the V1-1459 lane (PR #974, base origin/main around c4a752222/6f5272b5f, Darwin arm64, Go 1.27.1, host load average ~80): internal/tasks/store TestPSRSweepOwnerBarrier fails at the unmodified base as well as on the branch. The test uses a 2 s deadline (internal/tasks/store/pool_sweep_test.go ~146). In the same run, the full store package hit the 30m timeout on unrelated program_* tests (context canceled). Expected: the test is deterministic under load, either by not depending on wall-clock time or by using a deadline derived from the test's own budget. Actual: a load-sensitive failure. Related: archived V1-0724 (PSR pool-sweep tests sensitive to host load).
title: TestPSRSweepOwnerBarrier fails at origin/main under host load (2 s deadline)
